source: URA Revit Model Quality Checker Plugin, User Guide section 7.4 (Validate Acceptable Vocabulary)
note: Values URA publishes that the CORENET X mapping workbook does not carry. Merged into the ruleset's Space Values at load, so a model using a value URA accepts is not reported as invalid. This file is hand-maintained and is NOT generated by tools/build-ifcsg-rules.ps1 — that is the point of keeping it separate, since data/ifcsg-rules.json is overwritten whenever the workbook is rebuilt.

AGF_BonusGFAType.note: In the URA guide's list; absent from the workbook's 10 bonus GFA schemes.

AST_AreaType.note: The URA guide's spelling. The workbook spells the same concept 'Common Area'; both are accepted rather than guessing which the reviewer applies.

verifiedIdentical.AGF_DevelopmentUse: All 25 values match the workbook exactly.
verifiedIdentical.AGF_BuildingTypology: All 13 values the guide lists are among the workbook's 29; the workbook additionally carries Polyclinic, Data Centre, Community Club / Centre, Adult Disability Home, Medical Centre, Public Acute Hospital, Public Community Hospital, Private Hospital, Assisted Living Facility, Confinement Centre, Service Apartment II, Adventure Centre / Campsite, Farm, Airport and Port.
